text:
𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗠𝗔𝗧 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗛 𝗜𝗦 𝗧𝗢𝗣 𝟭𝟬! 🇦🇫

Afghanistan's captain climbs six places to 7th in the ICC Test batting rankings (735 pts) after 173 v Zimbabwe.
First Afghan in any Test top 10.

Big moment? 👇

#Cricket #Afghanistan

facebook.caption:
𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗠𝗔𝗧 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗛 𝗧𝗢𝗣 𝟭𝟬 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡! 🇦🇫🔥

👉 Afghanistan ke captain Rahmat Shah ICC Test batting rankings mein 6 spot upar chadhkar 7th par
👉 735 rating points, Zimbabwe ke khilaf 173 ki badaulat
👉 Afghanistan ke pehle player jo kisi bhi Test top 10 mein pahunche

Kya Afghanistan ka Test cricket mein ye naya daur hai? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #Afghanistan #TestCricket
